intent: Compare the U.S. vegan population share between the two years shown and report how the share changed across the full time span.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Compare the U.S. vegan population share between the two years shown
Report how the share changed across the full time span

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in U.S. vegan population.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: The U.S. vegan population share was 0.5% in 2008 and 2.5% in 2014.
accept: Shows both the 2008 share (0.5%) and the 2014 share (2.5%) as distinct states
Both year-state values are visually represented in the partial ring frames
reject: Shows only one of the two year shares
Uses a single static value without distinguishing the two years

units.claim: The U.S. vegan population share increased from 0.5% in 2008 to 2.5% in 2014, a change of +2.0 percentage points.
accept: Reports an increase of 2.0 percentage points (or equivalent relative change) from 2008 to 2014
Conveys the direction (increase) and magnitude of change across the full span
reject: Reports only the endpoint values without any change/difference
Reports a decrease or wrong magnitude of change

optional_valid: Labeling each frame with its year (2008, 2014) to bind states to time
Showing the percentage-point difference as an annotation
unsupported_to_avoid: Adding shares from the two years together
Treating the 2.5% as a share of the 0.5% without stating a relative-change framing
Enumerating unrelated sectors or entities not in the table
Inferring a remainder complement since the whole is the total U.S. population, not a part-to-whole sector breakdown
review_notes: Intent asks for both a between-year comparison and the change across the full span; these are kept as two units because omitting either leaves the intent incomplete.
The partial ring is a gauge-like share of the U.S. population; no inferred_remainder unit is created because the complement (non-vegan share) is not requested by the intent.
State_change unit U1 covers the two endpoint states; U2 covers the derived difference, which is the explicit second obligation.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
